tool_calls.arguments: {"old":"\"Oh Father, in again? Shameless, are you not,\" she laughed with a guiltless laugh.","new":"\"Oh Father, in again? No let-up, is there,\" she laughed with a guiltless laugh.","reason":"Japanese 幕なし means without a break/intermission, i.e. bathing again without pause, not moral shamelessness.","replace_all":false}

tool_calls.name: edit
tool_calls.arguments: {"old":"Sorrow heaped with pique came to an ear, \"Father, it is so dull, I shall go home too,\" she said, sullen and sharp with it.","new":"Sorrow heaped with pique found voice: \"Father, it is so dull, I shall go home too,\" she said, sullen and sharp with it.","reason":"Japanese 穂にあらわれて means the feeling showed/came out, not literally 'came to an ear' (穂 as grain-ear).","replace_all":false}

tool_calls.arguments: {"old":"now, drawn to sadness by the deer-cries that reached across the ridge, the tread of feet passing to and fro along the corridors grew faintly lonely.","new":"now, drawn to sadness by the deer-whistles that reached across the ridge, the tread of feet passing to and fro along the corridors grew faintly lonely.","reason":"Japanese 鹿笛 is a deer-whistle/call, an instrument sound, not deer themselves crying.","replace_all":false}
